description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a professional committed to long-term engagement and making a significant impact on patient care and team leadership.In this vital leadership role, you will contribute to maintaining high standards of nursing care, overseeing clinical operations, and supporting the Director of Nursing. Your expertise will be crucial in fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.This position offers a chance to thrive in a supportive setting within a skilled nursing facility, focusing on delivering exceptional care and operational excellence.
requirements: Prior experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably within a skilled nursing facility.
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position; interim candidates will not be considered.
Demonstrated ability to supervise staff and ensure high-quality patient care.
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance.
